summary: BTC Digital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a $7M registered-direct/private placement of 6,140,350 Common Units at $1.14 per unit, each consisting of one ordinary share (or pre-funded warrant) plus two PIPE warrants exercisable at $1.71 for 60 months. The offering closed on June 29, 2026, conducted under Section 4(a)(2) with Aegis Capital as sole placement agent on a best-efforts basis, earning 7% commission. The warrants include a 4.99% (or up to 9.99%) beneficial ownership limitation. This is a standard capital raise, not a special situation, as it involves no change of control, tender, or restructuring.
